lines: They too become graced thus — so in the animal-rite
by compassion one should not doubt.
l4.sanskrit_cite: te 'pi hi evam anugṛhītā bhavanti iti kāruṇikatayā paśuvidhau na vicikitset

c1_essence: By compassion in the animal-rite: no doubt — they too become graced.
